_comment: What goes IN each plugin. marketplace.json holds the metadata and version;
this file holds the composition. plugins/ is generated from the two of them by
scripts/generate-plugins.mjs and is disposable: never hand-edit anything under it.
A skill listed under two plugins is stored once in shared-skills/ and copied into
both at build time. That is the point of the split.
knowledge/ files are detected automatically from `knowledge/<file>.md` references
inside each skill, so you only list one here to force-include a file no skill names.
Adding a plugin: add a block here AND an entry in marketplace.json. The generator
fails loudly if one exists without the other, so a half-added plugin can never ship.
